standards.title: Tabs Pattern
standards.authority: W3C WAI ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
application: Preserve active-tab focus, arrow navigation and tab/panel relationships.
Keep selected state and accessible labels synchronized.
Automatic activation depends on panel latency; Home and End are optional.

standards.title: Disclosure (Show/Hide) Pattern
standards.authority: W3C WAI ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
application: Use a keyboard-operable visibility control with synchronized expanded state.
Provide a discoverable way to reopen collapsed content.
existing_checks: tools/ui_audit.py: reference disclosure keyboard and focus checks
limitations: Preserving scientific settings and exposing hidden errors are project safeguards.
The guidance does not establish an optimal sidebar position, category count, mode name or initial plot count.
